```{r script-info, include=FALSE}
# This script was used to create the following figures:
# Figure 2g (metastasis sections: cell types, stemness score and CNV score maps)
# Figure 2h and Supplementary Figure 5b (chr3 loss / chr8 gain iCNV maps of the melanoma cells, metastasis sections)
# Figure 2i (stemness vs CNV score per melanoma cell, metastasis sections, Pearson R)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(qs2); library(data.table); library(ggplot2); library(patchwork) })
source("colors_2026b.R")

# Raw inputs (Seurat objects, iCNV h5ad files), set on the render command; layout in the Methods tab
xenium_dir <- params$xenium_dir
out_boston <- "../Outputs/Xenium_Stemness_Boston_2026b"
out_pum26  <- "../Outputs/Xenium_Stemness_pUM26_2026b"
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("tables", showWarnings = FALSE)

# Stemness signature on the 5,001-gene panel: gene correlations with the CytoTRACE2 score in malignant atlas cells
# (CytoTRACE2.Rmd), restricted to panel genes; the 50 most positively correlated genes are scored.
panel_top50 <- function(panel, n = 50) {
  cr <- fread("../Outputs/CytoTRACE2_2026b/gene_cor_malignant.csv")[gene %in% panel & !is.na(correlation)]
  cr[order(-correlation)][1:n, gene]
}
# UCell with maxRank 150: most Xenium cells detect < 500 panel genes, beyond rank ~150 only zero-count ties remain
ucell_stemness <- function(counts) {
  S <- UCell::ScoreSignatures_UCell(counts, features = list(Top = panel_top50(rownames(counts))), name = "",
                                    maxRank = 150, ncores = 8)
  S[colnames(counts), "Top"]
}

# Raster size and point radius of one section map: >= 4000 px on the short side, aspect ratio kept, point radius
# 0.9 x the median distance between neighbouring cell centroids so the tissue reads as filled.
spatial_raster <- function(x, y, short_px = 4000, max_px = 20000, frac = 0.9) {
  xr <- diff(range(x)) * 1.1; yr <- diff(range(y)) * 1.1
  ratio <- max(xr, yr) / min(xr, yr)
  short_px <- min(short_px, max_px / ratio)
  px <- if (yr >= xr) c(short_px, short_px * ratio) else c(short_px * ratio, short_px)
  nn <- median(RANN::nn2(cbind(x, y), k = 2)$nn.dists[, 2])
  list(px = round(px), pointsize = max(1, frac * nn * px[1] / xr))
}
map_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 22) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), legend.title = element_text(size = 33),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 26.4), legend.key.size = unit(0.55, "in"))
title_theme <- theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
cytotrace_colors <- c("#000004FF", "#3B0F70FF", "#8C2981FF", "#DE4968FF", "#FE9F6DFF", "#FCFDBFFF")
Q <- c(0.01, 0.99)   # colour caps (percentiles), values beyond take the end colour

# Three maps of one section: cell types | stemness | CNV. f: x, y, celltype, stem, cnv
spatial_3panel <- function(f, ct_cols, stem_lim, cnv_scale, cnv_title, title) {
  ras <- spatial_raster(f$x, f$y)
  pt <- function() scattermore::geom_scattermore(pointsize = ras$pointsize, pixels = ras$px)
  ax <- labs(x = "x (µm)", y = "y (µm)")
  p1 <- ggplot(f, aes(x, y, colour = celltype)) + pt() +
    scale_colour_manual(values = ct_cols, drop = TRUE, name = "Cell type") +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 9))) + coord_fixed() + map_theme + ax + labs(title = "Cell types")
  p2 <- ggplot(f[order(stem)], aes(x, y, colour = stem)) + pt() +   # highest score drawn on top
    scale_colour_gradientn(colours = cytotrace_colors, limits = stem_lim, oob = scales::squish,
                           name = sprintf("Stemness\n(UCell)\ncapped at\n%g-%gth pct", 100 * Q[1], 100 * Q[2])) +
    coord_fixed() + map_theme + ax + labs(title = "Stemness\n(Top 50 panel genes)")
  p3 <- ggplot(f[order(!is.na(cnv), abs(cnv))], aes(x, y, colour = cnv)) + pt() + cnv_scale +
    coord_fixed() + map_theme + ax + labs(title = cnv_title)
  (p1 | p2 | p3) + plot_annotation(title = title, theme = title_theme)
}
map_height <- function(x, y, per_panel = 6.2) round(min(26, max(9.5, per_panel * diff(range(y)) / diff(range(x)) + 3)), 1)

# Stemness vs per-cell CNV RMS in melanoma cells, one facet per section. Pearson R on cells within a section:
# cell-level and descriptive, so no p-value (cells are not independent replicates).
stem_cnv_scatter <- function(m, ylab, ncol = 3, labeller = "label_value") {
  ggplot(as.data.frame(m), aes(stem, cnv_rms)) +
    geom_point(colour = "grey50", alpha = 0.2, size = 0.5) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, colour = "black", se = TRUE, linewidth = 0.8) +
    ggpubr::stat_cor(aes(label = after_stat(sprintf("italic(R)~`=`~%s", signif(r, 2)))), method = "pearson",
                     label.x.npc = 0.05, label.y.npc = 0.95, size = 3.5, geom = "label", fill = "white", border.colour = NA) +
    facet_wrap(~sample, scales = "free", ncol = ncol, labeller = labeller) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")) +
    labs(x = "Stemness score (Top 50 panel genes, UCell)", y = ylab,
         title = "Melanoma cells: CNV score vs stemness score (per section)",
         subtitle = "Pearson R on cells within each section: cell-level, descriptive (no p-value)")
}

# Figure panels: PDF + PNG in figures/, PNG shown in the report
save_panel <- function(p, name, w, h) {
  png <- file.path("figures", paste0(name, ".png"))
  ggsave(png, p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 300, bg = "white", limitsize = FALSE)
  ggsave(file.path("figures", paste0(name, ".pdf")), p, width = w, height = h, device = cairo_pdf)
  png
}
show_tabs <- function(pngs) for (s in names(pngs)) cat("###", s, "\n\n![](", pngs[[s]], ")\n\n", sep = "")
need <- function(f, how) if (!file.exists(f)) stop(f, " is missing: ", how)
```

```{r boston-data, include=FALSE}
# Per-cell stemness score, cell type, coordinates and per-cluster CNV score of the metastasis sections (computed once)
boston_cache <- file.path(out_boston, "boston_scores_2026b.qs2")
if (!file.exists(boston_cache)) {
  library(Seurat)
  obj <- qs_read(file.path(xenium_dir, "boston/xenium_boston.qs2"))
  counts <- LayerData(obj, assay = "Xenium", layer = "counts")
  md <- obj@meta.data
  cells <- data.table(cell = colnames(obj), sample = md$Sample, tissue = md$Tissue_Type, timepoint = md$Timepoint,
                      response = md$Best_Response, celltype = as.character(md$CellType_Display),
                      panel_malignant_Top = ucell_stemness(counts))
  coords <- rbindlist(lapply(Images(obj), function(f) as.data.table(GetTissueCoordinates(obj, image = f, which = "centroids"))))
  cells[coords, on = "cell", `:=`(x = i.x, y = i.y)]
  cnv <- fread(file.path(xenium_dir, "boston/cnv_scores_per_cluster.csv"))[, cell := paste0(sample, "_", cell_barcode)]
  cells[cnv, on = "cell", cnv_score := i.cnv_score]
  qs_save(list(cells = cells), boston_cache)
}
d <- qs_read(boston_cache, nthreads = 1)$cells[, .(cell, sample, tissue, timepoint, response, celltype, panel_malignant_Top,
                                                   x, y, cnv_score)]
d[, barcode := substring(cell, nchar(sample) + 2)]
# Per-cell CNV RMS of the InSituCNV run without neighbour smoothing (Xenium_CNV_Stemness_Correlation.Rmd)
jan <- fread(file.path(out_boston, "inputs/cnv_january_unsmoothed_report18.csv"), select = c("Sample", "barcode_suffix", "cnv_score"))
d[jan, on = .(sample = Sample, barcode = barcode_suffix), cnv_rms := i.cnv_score]

samples <- d[, .N, by = .(sample, tissue, timepoint, response)][order(tissue != "Liver", sample)]
d[, sample := factor(sample, levels = samples$sample)]
# Maps show the atlas cell types; hepatocytes, cholangiocytes, mast cells and unassigned cells are Other/Unknown
atlas_ct <- intersect(d[celltype != "Unknown", .N, by = celltype][order(-N), celltype], names(majority_celltype_col))
d[, celltype_atlas := factor(fifelse(celltype %in% atlas_ct, celltype, "Other/Unknown"), levels = c(atlas_ct, "Other/Unknown"))]
ct_cols <- c(majority_celltype_col, "Other/Unknown" = "#D9D9D9")
mel <- d[celltype == "Melanoma cells"]
```

```{r pum26-data, include=FALSE}
pum_lab <- c(pUM26_eye = "pUM26 primary eye tumour", pUM26_liver = "pUM26 liver metastasis")
# Stored iCNV per cell (chr3, chr8q, centroids), from Xenium_Stemness_icnv.py
for (p in names(pum_lab)) need(file.path(out_pum26, paste0(p, "_icnv_obs.csv")),
                               "run python -I Xenium_Stemness_icnv.py <xenium_dir> ../Outputs")
pum_cache <- file.path(out_pum26, "pum26_scores_2026b.qs2")
if (!file.exists(pum_cache)) {
  objs <- lapply(names(pum_lab), function(p) qs_read(file.path(xenium_dir, "pUM26", p, "scData_SPLIT.qs2")))
  counts <- lapply(objs, function(o) SeuratObject::LayerData(o, assay = "Xenium", layer = "counts"))
  stopifnot(identical(rownames(counts[[1]]), rownames(counts[[2]])))
  cells <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_along(objs), function(i)
    data.table(cell = colnames(objs[[i]]), sample = names(pum_lab)[i], refined_immune_type = objs[[i]]$refined_immune_type)))
  cells[, panel_malignant_Top := ucell_stemness(do.call(cbind, counts))]
  icnv <- rbindlist(lapply(names(pum_lab), function(p) fread(file.path(out_pum26, paste0(p, "_icnv_obs.csv")))))
  cells[icnv, on = c(cell = "barcode"), `:=`(chr3_cnv = i.chr3_cnv, chr8q_cnv = i.chr8q_cnv, x = i.x_centroid, y = i.y_centroid)]
  cells[, cnv_directed := chr8q_cnv - chr3_cnv]   # UM hallmark: chr8q gain minus chr3 loss
  qs_save(list(cells = cells), pum_cache)
}
pu <- qs_read(pum_cache, nthreads = 1)$cells[, .(cell, sample, refined_immune_type, panel_malignant_Top, x, y, cnv_directed)]
# Per-cell CNV RMS without neighbour smoothing, from Xenium_Stemness_unsmoothed_icnv.py
uns <- rbindlist(lapply(names(pum_lab), function(p) {
  f <- file.path(out_pum26, paste0(p, "_icnv_unsmoothed.csv"))
  need(f, sprintf("run python Xenium_Stemness_unsmoothed_icnv.py <xenium_dir> ../Outputs %s", p))
  fread(f, select = c("barcode", "cnv_rms_unsmoothed"))
}))
pu[uns, on = c(cell = "barcode"), cnv_rms := i.cnv_rms_unsmoothed]
stopifnot(!anyNA(pu$cnv_rms))

# Refined RCTD labels coarsened to the atlas cell types
coarsen <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x); x[is.na(x)] <- "Unknown"
  dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("Malignant|Melanoma|Cancer", x, ignore.case = TRUE)                 ~ "Melanoma cells",
    grepl("Melanocyt|pigmented epithelial", x, ignore.case = TRUE)            ~ "Melanocytes",
    grepl("CD4|CD8|T_NK|T cell|Treg|MAIT|gdT|T_cytotoxic|T_naive|T_exhausted|T_helper|natural killer|NK_CYTO|NK_REST|NK cell|\\bNK\\b", x, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "T/NK cells",
    grepl("B cell|B_cell|Plasma", x, ignore.case = TRUE)                      ~ "B/Plasma cells",
    grepl("Macrophage|TAM|Myeloid|Monocyte|Mono-derived|\\bDC\\b|cDC|pDC|dendritic|microglia|Basophil|Neutrophil|Mast|Kupffer|ISG expressing immune", x, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Myeloid cells",
    grepl("Endothel|\\bLEC\\b|\\bVEC\\b", x, ignore.case = TRUE)              ~ "Endothelial cells",
    grepl("Fibroblast", x, ignore.case = TRUE)                               ~ "Fibroblasts",
    grepl("Pericyte", x, ignore.case = TRUE)                                 ~ "Pericytes",
    grepl("Epithelial|Hepatocyte|Cholangiocyte", x, ignore.case = TRUE)      ~ "Epithelial cells",
    TRUE ~ "Other/Unknown")
}
pu[, celltype := coarsen(refined_immune_type)]
pu_levels <- c(setdiff(pu[, .N, by = celltype][order(-N), celltype], "Other/Unknown"), "Other/Unknown")
pu[, `:=`(celltype = factor(celltype, levels = pu_levels), sample = factor(sample, levels = names(pum_lab)))]
pu_mel <- pu[celltype == "Melanoma cells"]
```

# {.tabset}

## Overview

Started on `r format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")`

**Purpose**: map the atlas-derived stemness score and inferred CNV (iCNV) in single-cell spatial transcriptomics (Xenium 5K, 5,001-gene panel) and relate the two within melanoma cells.

**Data**: `r nrow(samples)` metastasis sections from five patients (`r sum(samples$tissue == "Liver")` liver, `r sum(samples$tissue == "Breast")` breast; `r format(nrow(d), big.mark = ",")` cells, `r format(nrow(mel), big.mark = ",")` melanoma cells), and patient pUM26 (primary eye tumour and liver metastasis, `r format(nrow(pu), big.mark = ",")` cells).

**Stemness score**: UCell score of the 50 panel genes most positively correlated with the CytoTRACE2 score in malignant atlas cells (CytoTRACE2.Rmd).

**Statistics**: Pearson R between stemness and the per-cell CNV score, on the melanoma cells of each section. These are cell-level and descriptive (cells of one section are not independent replicates), so no p-value is given; no between-group test is made.

## Fig. 2g {.tabset}

Cell types, stemness score and CNV score on the same coordinates. Stemness colours are capped at the 1st and 99th percentile of all cells of the six sections, the CNV score at the 99th percentile of melanoma cells. The CNV score is the per-CNV-cluster mean |iCNV| of melanoma cells and 0 for all other cells; grey cells are absent from the iCNV run.

```{r fig2g, results='asis'}
stem_lim <- quantile(d$panel_malignant_Top, Q)
cnv_hi <- quantile(mel$cnv_score, Q[2], na.rm = TRUE)
fig2g <- sapply(samples$sample, function(s) {
  f <- d[sample == s, .(x, y, celltype = celltype_atlas, stem = panel_malignant_Top, cnv = cnv_score)]
  i <- samples[sample == s]
  p <- spatial_3panel(f, ct_cols, stem_lim,
                      cnv_scale = scale_colour_viridis_c(limits = c(0, cnv_hi), oob = scales::squish, na.value = "grey80",
                                                         name = sprintf("CNV score\ncapped at\n%gth pct\n(grey = no CNV)", 100 * Q[2])),
                      cnv_title = "CNV score\n(0 = non-melanoma cell)",
                      title = sprintf("%s | %s | %s | best response %s, %s cells", s, i$tissue, i$timepoint, i$response,
                                      format(nrow(f), big.mark = ",")))
  save_panel(p, paste0("Fig2g_spatial_", s), 34, map_height(f$x, f$y))
})
show_tabs(fig2g)
```

## Fig. 2h, Suppl. Fig. 5b {.tabset}

Mean iCNV over the chr3 and over the chr8 windows in each melanoma cell (blue = loss, red = gain), other cells grey. Symmetric colour limit = 99th percentile of |iCNV| in the melanoma cells of the section.

```{r fig2h, results='asis'}
chr_csv <- file.path(out_boston, "cnv_chr3_chr8_per_cell.csv")
need(chr_csv, "run python -I Xenium_Stemness_icnv.py <xenium_dir> ../Outputs")
pc <- fread(chr_csv)[, is_mel := grepl("melanoma", cell_type, ignore.case = TRUE)]
icnv_map <- function(f, col, title, ras) {
  m <- f[is_mel == TRUE][order(abs(get(col)))][, v := fcoalesce(get(col), 0)]
  lim <- as.numeric(quantile(abs(m$v), Q[2]))
  ggplot() +
    scattermore::geom_scattermore(data = f[is_mel == FALSE], aes(x, y), colour = "grey85", pointsize = ras$pointsize, pixels = ras$px) +
    scattermore::geom_scattermore(data = m, aes(x, y, colour = v), pointsize = ras$pointsize, pixels = ras$px) +
    scale_colour_distiller(palette = "RdBu", limits = c(-lim, lim), oob = scales::squish, name = "inferred\nCNV") +
    coord_fixed() + labs(title = title, x = "x (µm)", y = "y (µm)") + map_theme +
    theme(legend.key.height = unit(0.9, "in"), legend.key.width = unit(0.45, "in"))
}
fig2h <- sapply(samples$sample, function(s) {
  f <- pc[sample == s]
  ras <- spatial_raster(f$x, f$y)
  p <- (icnv_map(f, "chr3_cnv", "chr3 (loss = blue)", ras) | icnv_map(f, "chr8_cnv", "chr8 (gain = red)", ras)) +
    plot_annotation(title = sprintf("%s | %s | %s melanoma cells, grey = other cells", s, samples[sample == s, tissue],
                                    format(sum(f$is_mel), big.mark = ",")), theme = title_theme)
  save_panel(p, paste0("Fig2h_SFig5b_iCNV_chr3_chr8_", s), 23, map_height(f$x, f$y, per_panel = 8.5))
})
show_tabs(fig2h)
```

## Fig. 2i

```{r fig2i, results='asis'}
m <- mel[!is.na(cnv_rms), .(sample, stem = panel_malignant_Top, cnv_rms)]
r_boston <- m[, .(n_cells = .N, pearson_r = cor(stem, cnv_rms)), by = sample]
fwrite(r_boston, "tables/Fig2i_pearson_r.csv")
cat("![](", save_panel(stem_cnv_scatter(m, "CNV score (per-cell RMS, iCNV without smoothing)"), "Fig2i_stemness_vs_cnv", 14, 10), ")\n\n", sep = "")
```

One point per melanoma cell with a CNV value, black line = linear fit with 95% band. CNV score = per-cell RMS of the iCNV profile over all windows, from the InSituCNV run without neighbour smoothing.

## Suppl. Fig. 5a {.tabset}

As Fig. 2g for pUM26, with the directed iCNV score (chr8q gain minus chr3 loss) as CNV panel. Both colour scales are shared by the two sections: stemness capped at the 1st and 99th percentile, the CNV score at the 99th percentile of its absolute value.

```{r sfig5a, results='asis'}
pu_stem_lim <- quantile(pu$panel_malignant_Top, Q)
cnv_lim <- quantile(abs(pu$cnv_directed), Q[2])
sfig5a <- sapply(levels(pu$sample), function(s) {
  f <- pu[sample == s, .(x, y, celltype, stem = panel_malignant_Top, cnv = cnv_directed)]
  p <- spatial_3panel(f, ct_cols, pu_stem_lim,
                      cnv_scale = scale_colour_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "grey70", high = "#B2182B", midpoint = 0,
                                                         limits = c(-cnv_lim, cnv_lim), oob = scales::squish,
                                                         name = sprintf("chr8q - chr3\nCNV, capped at\n%gth pct of |value|", 100 * Q[2])),
                      cnv_title = "Directed iCNV score\n(chr8q gain minus chr3 loss)",
                      title = sprintf("%s, %s cells", pum_lab[s], format(nrow(f), big.mark = ",")))
  save_panel(p, paste0("SFig5a_spatial_", s), 34, map_height(f$x, f$y))
})
show_tabs(sfig5a)
```

## Methods

- **Inputs** under `params$xenium_dir`: `boston/xenium_boston.qs2` (Seurat object of the six metastasis sections, raw Xenium counts, RCTD cell types merged to the atlas names in `CellType_Display`), `boston/cnv_scores_per_cluster.csv` (per-CNV-cluster score), `boston/cnv/<section>_cnv.h5ad` (InSituCNV results); `pUM26/<section>/scData_SPLIT.qs2` (SPLIT-purified counts, refined RCTD labels), `pUM26/<section>/icnv_cnv.h5ad` and `icnv_input.h5ad` (iCNV run and its input).
- **Stemness**: UCell (maxRank 150) of the Top 50 panel genes on the counts of every cell; ranks are within a cell, so scores do not depend on the other cells. Cached in `../Outputs/Xenium_Stemness_{Boston,pUM26}_2026b/*_scores_2026b.qs2`.
- **iCNV** (infercnvpy, macrophages as diploid reference, window 100 genes, step 10): Fig. 2g CNV score = mean |iCNV| per CNV cluster of melanoma cells, 0 for other cells (smoothed run). Fig. 2h / Suppl. Fig. 5b = mean iCNV over the chr3 and chr8 windows (`Xenium_Stemness_icnv.py`). Suppl. Fig. 5a = mean iCNV over the chr8q windows (distal half of chr8) minus the chr3 mean. Fig. 2i / Suppl. Fig. 5c = per-cell RMS over all windows of the run without neighbour smoothing (pUM26: `Xenium_Stemness_unsmoothed_icnv.py`).
- **Statistics**: Pearson R per section on melanoma cells (`tables/`), cell-level and descriptive, no p-value.
- **Run order**: `python -I Xenium_Stemness_icnv.py <xenium_dir> ../Outputs`, then `python Xenium_Stemness_unsmoothed_icnv.py <xenium_dir> ../Outputs <section>` for both pUM26 sections (infercnvpy env), then render with `params = list(xenium_dir = ...)`.
